categories.main_business_segments: Henan Qingshuiyuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in water treatment chemicals production and sales, industrial water treatment engineering, and environmental comprehensive management. The company has developed into a group covering water treatment chemical R&D, production, sales, industrial water treatment services, municipal sewage treatment, and ecological restoration. It owns multiple subsidiaries specializing in water treatment chemicals, environmental engineering, intelligent water treatment systems, and related equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced industrialized production technologies for water treatment chemicals such as HEDP, ATMP, HPMA, DTPMP, and chloromethane, employing continuous online production, multi-stage reaction towers, and gas protection systems. It emphasizes energy-saving, pollution reduction, and product quality stability through process innovation and automation. The company also develops intelligent water treatment systems integrating industrial internet platforms for dynamic monitoring and smart dosing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial sectors such as chemical, steel, power, petrochemical, mining, papermaking, and municipal water treatment entities. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for about 25% of revenue. Its products and services cater to industrial water treatment, municipal and drinking water treatment, sewage and wastewater treatment, and environmental protection projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Jiyuan, Henan Province. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shanghai, Beijing, Shaanxi, Hainan, and overseas in the United States. The company exports products internationally, serving global markets with a significant portion of revenue derived from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Qingshuiyuan is positioned midstream in the water treatment industry supply chain, focusing on the production of water treatment chemicals and providing downstream industrial and municipal water treatment services. It also extends upstream by procuring key chemical raw materials and downstream through engineering, equipment sales, and operation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in green and environmentally friendly water treatment chemicals, including low-phosphorus, nitrogen-free, biodegradable, and non-toxic products. It invests in R&D for new polymeric flocculants, multifunctional composite agents, nano-materials, and microbial flocculants. The firm also focuses on digital transformation, integrating AI, big data, and industrial internet technologies to enhance intelligent water treatment and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of water treatment chemicals and derivative products, engineering contracting services (EPC, BOT, BT models), equipment sales, and operation and maintenance services. The company also earns income from government subsidies and other non-operating income sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic enterprises in the water treatment chemical industry, with a significant production capacity of 270,000 tons per year. It competes with about 10-20 large-scale domestic producers, including listed companies like Taihe Technology. The market is fragmented with intense competition, but Qingshuiyuan holds a core competitive advantage due to its scale, technology, and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, a 3.77% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 58.6 million. Despite the loss, cash flow from operating activities improved by nearly 70%. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.56 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.43 billion, reflecting a stable but challenging growth environment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced water treatment chemicals with a broad product portfolio tailored to diverse industrial and municipal applications. It differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, environmental compliance, and integrated intelligent water treatment solutions. Its commitment to green chemistry and digital innovation enhances customer value by improving efficiency, reducing costs, and supporting sustainable water resource management.
